urls.title: Websites or domains
urls.description: Websites to analyze, one per line. Bare domains (example.com) or full URLs. Up to 10,000 per run.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel sites
maxConcurrency.description: How many sites are analyzed in parallel.

waitMs.title: Extra wait after load (ms)
waitMs.description: Time to let tag managers and late scripts load before detection. Higher finds more marketing/analytics tools.

includeEvidence.title: Include evidence
includeEvidence.description: Add which signals (header, script, cookie, meta, DOM, JS global) matched for each technology.
